choreography.after_E29: Reset; no later Lisp row on this state.

choreography.staging_order: All three D81 files are staged and SHA-read back before product start. The JTAG FTP helper overwrites guest RAM and resets on exit; never invoke it while preserving a live Lisp world. Subsequent media changes use only owner Freezer mount. The original cold-start B observation is preserved; the owner-approved restart after restaging is reported separately, not as a new cold power cycle.
choreography.variant_A: Only if owner confirms persistent autoboot setup; never presume RAM upload survives power loss.
